physical_source.chronology_review: Selected direct front/back review pages p1-p12 and p184-p195 did not yield a secure internal year, colophon date or copy note sufficient to date this reviewed physical/textual state before 1578.
physical_source.chronology_firewall: Ming attribution alone does not authorize a pre-1578 ancestry claim. The reviewed object remains a Ming manuscript control of unresolved exact copy date.

direct_physical_collation.adjudication_method: Direct visual inspection of source-bound 320dpi renders from the exact workflow artifact. OCR is locator-only and is not final glyph authority.

comparison_with_sanming_1578.consequence: A shared 59/41 endpoint plus a broadly similar stepped whole-ke architecture is insufficient to identify this reviewed Datonglizhu text state as the unchanged Sanming 1578 parent table.

mechanism_scope.safe_consequence: NCL-06627 strengthens a compound calendrical architecture in which term-state thresholds and day/night whole-ke schedules coexist, but does not close the operator linking them.

transmission_impact.lineage_scope: Direct Ming manuscript mechanical/recensional control. It strengthens the structural mechanism family while negatively adjudicating unchanged-table identity with Sanming 1578. Exact chronology remains insufficient for pre-1578 ancestry.

next_gate: Prioritize a securely pre-1578 Datong/Tongshu/Datonglizhu witness that reproduces the Sanming high-information change-day fingerprint rather than merely the 59/41 endpoint.
Search for an explicit operator connecting winter-solstice-remainder or arrow/table state selection to the whole-ke schedule, while preserving the already closed C-II-N interior thresholds.
Keep NCL-06627 as a divergent control recension: its Dahan and Yushui change-day loci must not be silently normalized into the Sanming 1578 fingerprint.
